$comment: The known state of the TheDancingDeveloper-org/vogt-fixture repository. scripts/fixture_reset.py rebuilds the repo to match this via the API (close/reopen/relabel; never deletes history), and the `live_forge` tests assert the live reads against `expected`. The `number` fields hold for a *fresh* fixture repo built in this order: GitHub shares one counter between issues and pull requests, so the five issues take #1-#5 and the four pull requests take #6-#9. After the first build the script is idempotent and never renumbers.
